create_ORPOConfig: create an ORPOConfig dataclass instance with custom learning_rate, beta, and max_length parameters
build_ORPO_training_args: build ORPO training arguments via argparse using HfArgumentParser to parse ORPOConfig fields from the command line
configure_ORPO_loss_beta: configure the beta parameter controlling the relative ratio loss weight in ORPO training
test_ORPOConfig_defaults: test the ORPOConfig dataclass default values for learning_rate, beta, disable_dropout, and max_length
review_ORPOConfig_class: review the ORPOConfig dataclass and its inherited fields from _BaseConfig for ORPO training
